title: ADR 0018: Name-based navigation — `find_symbol` (workspace/symbol) + `symbols_overview` (documentSymbol)
summary: Adds name-based LSP navigation tools find_symbol and symbols_overview returning named Symbol results, closing the Protostar name-to-position gap.
notes: Status is 'Proposed' (though noted implemented same day), so locked=false per Accepted-only rule.
